G'oya

Domen @ dan keyingi qism, uni SUBSTR bilan @ ning o'rnidan bitta keyin boshlab olamiz. Harflar farqini yo'qotish uchun natijani LOWER qilamiz va guruhlashni aynan shu kichik harfli domen bo'yicha qilamiz.

Yechim

@ ning o'rnini PostgreSQL'da STRPOS, SQLite'da INSTR topadi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT LOWER(SUBSTR(email, STRPOS(email, '@') + 1)) AS domain,
       COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY LOWER(SUBSTR(email, STRPOS(email, '@') + 1))
ORDER BY user_count DESC, domain
Faqat SQLiteSELECT LOWER(SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1)) AS domain,
       COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY LOWER(SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1))
ORDER BY user_count DESC, domain

Namunada gmail.com va mail.ru uchta va ikkita foydalanuvchi bilan chiqadi: Dilnoza@Mail.ru ham mail.ru ga qo'shiladi.

Tuzoqlar

LOWER ni faqat SELECT da yozib, GROUP BY da unutish oson. Guruhlar baribir asl yozuv bo'yicha tuziladi va gmail.com ikki qatorda chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT LOWER(SUBSTR(email, STRPOS(email, '@') + 1)) AS domain,
       COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY SUBSTR(email, STRPOS(email, '@') + 1)
ORDER BY user_count DESC, domain

WHERE email IS NOT NULL siz emaili yo'q foydalanuvchilar NULL domenli alohida guruh bo'lib chiqadi.

Saralashda ikkinchi kalit (domain) shart: yandex.ru va inbox.uz ikkitadan bo'lsa, ularning tartibini faqat u belgilaydi.
